activities.title: AMAZING HOMES
activities.questionsInstruction: Complete the sentences. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage for each answer.

paragraphs.text: Most people live in a house or a flat. When they go on holiday they stay in a hotel or a guest house. But some places where you can live or stay are a bit different.

sentences.en: Most people live in a house or a flat.
sentences.vi: Hầu hết mọi người sống trong một ngôi nhà hoặc căn hộ.

sentences.en: When they go on holiday they stay in a hotel or a guest house.
sentences.vi: Khi đi nghỉ, họ thường ở khách sạn hoặc nhà nghỉ.

sentences.en: But some places where you can live or stay are a bit different.
sentences.vi: Nhưng một số nơi mà bạn có thể sinh sống hoặc lưu trú lại có phần khác biệt.

paragraphs.text: One unusual place to live is a houseboat. Amsterdam in Holland is famous for its houseboats - there are about 2,500 of them. They have everything that normal houses have: a living room, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom and even sometimes a terrace on the roof. They are cheaper than houses and people who live on houseboats enjoy being close to nature. Some houseboats can be moved to other parts of the river, while others are permanently in one place.

sentences.en: One unusual place to live is a houseboat.
sentences.vi: Một nơi ở khác thường là nhà thuyền.

sentences.en: Amsterdam in Holland is famous for its houseboats - there are about 2,500 of them.
sentences.vi: Amsterdam ở Hà Lan nổi tiếng với những ngôi nhà thuyền – có khoảng 2.500 ngôi nhà như vậy.

sentences.en: They have everything that normal houses have: a living room, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom and even sometimes a terrace on the roof.
sentences.vi: Chúng có mọi thứ mà những ngôi nhà bình thường có: phòng khách, phòng ngủ, nhà bếp, phòng tắm và đôi khi thậm chí còn có cả sân thượng trên mái.

sentences.en: They are cheaper than houses and people who live on houseboats enjoy being close to nature.
sentences.vi: Nhà thuyền rẻ hơn nhà ở thông thường và những người sống trên đó thích cảm giác được gần gũi với thiên nhiên.

sentences.en: Some houseboats can be moved to other parts of the river, while others are permanently in one place.
sentences.vi: Một số nhà thuyền có thể được di chuyển đến những khu vực khác của dòng sông, trong khi những ngôi nhà khác được neo cố định tại một chỗ.

paragraphs.text: In Tokyo, Japan, there is a see-through house. It is like a normal Japanese house but all the walls are made of glass. There is plenty of daylight but no privacy. Architect Sou Fujimoto designed it for a couple to make their home. He based his idea on early man living in trees. It wouldn't suit everyone but the couple who live there love the feeling of being surrounded by the natural world.

sentences.en: In Tokyo, Japan, there is a see-through house.
sentences.vi: Ở Tokyo, Nhật Bản, có một ngôi nhà trong suốt.

sentences.en: It is like a normal Japanese house but all the walls are made of glass.
sentences.vi: Nó giống như một ngôi nhà bình thường của Nhật Bản, nhưng tất cả các bức tường đều được làm bằng kính.

sentences.en: There is plenty of daylight but no privacy.
sentences.vi: Ngôi nhà có rất nhiều ánh sáng tự nhiên nhưng lại không có sự riêng tư.

sentences.en: Architect Sou Fujimoto designed it for a couple to make their home.
sentences.vi: Kiến trúc sư Sou Fujimoto đã thiết kế ngôi nhà này cho một cặp vợ chồng.

sentences.en: He based his idea on early man living in trees.
sentences.vi: Ông lấy cảm hứng từ ý tưởng về những người thời kỳ đầu sống trên cây.

sentences.en: It wouldn't suit everyone but the couple who live there love the feeling of being surrounded by the natural world.
sentences.vi: Kiểu nhà này không phù hợp với tất cả mọi người, nhưng cặp vợ chồng sống ở đó rất thích cảm giác được bao quanh bởi thế giới tự nhiên.

paragraphs.text: All around the world, people live in homes made from shipping containers. Some use only one container, while others are made from several containers joined together. One house in Chile was built from 12 containers. They are cheap to buy and eco-friendly. They can also be placed in the garden or drive as guest rooms, studies or utility rooms.

sentences.en: All around the world, people live in homes made from shipping containers.
sentences.vi: Trên khắp thế giới, mọi người sống trong những ngôi nhà được làm từ container vận chuyển hàng hóa.

sentences.en: Some use only one container, while others are made from several containers joined together.
sentences.vi: Một số ngôi nhà chỉ sử dụng một container, trong khi những ngôi nhà khác được làm từ nhiều container ghép lại với nhau.

sentences.en: One house in Chile was built from 12 containers.
sentences.vi: Một ngôi nhà ở Chile được xây dựng từ 12 container.

sentences.en: They are cheap to buy and eco-friendly.
sentences.vi: Những container này có giá mua rẻ và thân thiện với môi trường.

sentences.en: They can also be placed in the garden or drive as guest rooms, studies or utility rooms.
sentences.vi: Chúng cũng có thể được đặt trong vườn hoặc trên lối xe chạy vào nhà để làm phòng cho khách, phòng làm việc hoặc phòng tiện ích.

paragraphs.text: In Germany, you can stay in a one-metre-square house, the smallest house in the world, called the House NA. Van Bo Le-Mentzel, a refugee from Laos, built it to draw attention to the world housing shortage. It is a wooden structure on wheels and weighs 40 kg. It has a locking door and window. You can turn it onto its side when you want to lie down. Franz from Munich spent the night in one recently 'just to see what it was like'. He found it a bit uncomfortable!

sentences.en: In Germany, you can stay in a one-metre-square house, the smallest house in the world, called the House NA.
sentences.vi: Ở Đức, bạn có thể ở trong một ngôi nhà rộng một mét vuông, ngôi nhà nhỏ nhất thế giới, được gọi là House NA.

sentences.en: Van Bo Le-Mentzel, a refugee from Laos, built it to draw attention to the world housing shortage.
sentences.vi: Van Bo Le-Mentzel, một người tị nạn đến từ Lào, đã xây dựng ngôi nhà này nhằm thu hút sự chú ý đến tình trạng thiếu nhà ở trên thế giới.

sentences.en: It is a wooden structure on wheels and weighs 40 kg.
sentences.vi: Đây là một công trình bằng gỗ có bánh xe và nặng 40 kg.

sentences.en: It has a locking door and window.
sentences.vi: Nó có một cánh cửa có khóa và một cửa sổ.

sentences.en: You can turn it onto its side when you want to lie down.
sentences.vi: Bạn có thể xoay nó nằm nghiêng khi muốn nằm xuống.

sentences.en: Franz from Munich spent the night in one recently 'just to see what it was like'. He found it a bit uncomfortable!
sentences.vi: Franz đến từ Munich gần đây đã qua đêm trong một ngôi nhà như vậy 'chỉ để xem cảm giác sẽ như thế nào'. Anh thấy nó hơi không thoải mái!

paragraphs.text: For an unusual holiday you can stay in an igloo, a house made of ice. These can be found in several countries including Sweden, Norway and Finland. They are built new every winter. Jenny and Callum, visitors from Australia, told us, 'We slept in an igloo last night. It's so cold there - minus 5 degrees centigrade. We used reindeer skins to keep warm.'

sentences.en: For an unusual holiday you can stay in an igloo, a house made of ice.
sentences.vi: Để có một kỳ nghỉ khác thường, bạn có thể ở trong lều tuyết, một ngôi nhà làm bằng băng.

sentences.en: These can be found in several countries including Sweden, Norway and Finland.
sentences.vi: Những ngôi nhà như vậy có thể được tìm thấy ở một số quốc gia, bao gồm Thụy Điển, Na Uy và Phần Lan.

sentences.en: They are built new every winter.
sentences.vi: Chúng được xây mới vào mỗi mùa đông.

sentences.en: Jenny and Callum, visitors from Australia, told us, 'We slept in an igloo last night. It's so cold there - minus 5 degrees centigrade. We used reindeer skins to keep warm.'
sentences.vi: Jenny và Callum, hai du khách đến từ Úc, kể với chúng tôi: 'Đêm qua chúng tôi đã ngủ trong một căn lều tuyết. Ở đó lạnh đến mức nhiệt độ xuống tới âm 5 độ C. Chúng tôi đã mặc áo khoác da tuần lộc để giữ ấm.'

paragraphs.text: Another couple, Shaun and Rachel from Manchester, enjoyed a recent holiday in a treehouse in Sussex, England. They said, 'It was right up in the trees and had everything we needed, even wifi! It had a small kitchen and we did our own cooking. It was the perfect place to get away from our busy lives.'

sentences.en: Another couple, Shaun and Rachel from Manchester, enjoyed a recent holiday in a treehouse in Sussex, England.
sentences.vi: Một cặp đôi khác, Shaun và Rachel đến từ Manchester, đã tận hưởng một kỳ nghỉ gần đây trong một ngôi nhà trên cây ở Sussex, Anh.

sentences.en: They said, 'It was right up in the trees and had everything we needed, even wifi! It had a small kitchen and we did our own cooking. It was the perfect place to get away from our busy lives.'
sentences.vi: Họ cho biết: 'Ngôi nhà nằm ngay trên cao giữa những tán cây và có mọi thứ chúng tôi cần, thậm chí có cả Wi-Fi. Nó có một căn bếp nhỏ và chúng tôi tự nấu ăn. Đây là nơi hoàn hảo để rời xa cuộc sống bận rộn của mình.'

questions.text: The two people who live in the transparent house love it, but it wouldn't _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn B: 'It wouldn't suit everyone but the couple who live there love the feeling...'

questions.text: The designer of the smallest house hopes to _____ to the lack of houses all over the world.
questions.explanation: Đoạn D: 'Van Bo Le-Mentzel... built it to draw attention to the world housing shortage.'

questions.text: People who stay in igloos sometimes protect themselves from the cold by making use of _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn E: 'We used reindeer skins to keep warm.'

questions.text: People who have _____ would find a holiday in a treehouse ideal.
questions.explanation: Đoạn F: 'It was the perfect place to get away from our busy lives.'

activities.title: HOME FROM HOME
activities.questionsInstruction: Read the passage and complete the sentences below. Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage for each answer.

paragraphs.text: I remember feeling the first time I left home that I would never be able to feel at home anywhere but in my home. No other place would have my mum and dad, my annoying little brother and my cat, Tilly. Nowhere would smell like my home - my mum's roast chicken in the oven and the salty, seaweed smell that drifted in from the nearby beach. The sound of seagulls squawking was the sound of home. Nowhere else would I feel comfortable enough to put my feet up under me and gaze into the log fire dreaming of the future.

sentences.en: I remember feeling the first time I left home that I would never be able to feel at home anywhere but in my home.
sentences.vi: Tôi nhớ lần đầu tiên rời khỏi nhà, tôi đã cảm thấy rằng mình sẽ không bao giờ có thể cảm thấy thoải mái như ở nhà khi ở bất kỳ nơi nào khác.

sentences.en: No other place would have my mum and dad, my annoying little brother and my cat, Tilly.
sentences.vi: Không nơi nào khác có mẹ và bố đáng yêu của tôi, cậu em trai phiền phức của tôi và chú mèo Tilly.

sentences.en: Nowhere would smell like my home - my mum's roast chicken in the oven and the salty, seaweed smell that drifted in from the nearby beach.
sentences.vi: Không nơi nào có mùi giống như ở nhà – mùi món gà quay của mẹ trong lò nướng và mùi mằn mặn của rong biển trôi dạt vào từ bãi biển gần đó.

sentences.en: The sound of seagulls squawking was the sound of home.
sentences.vi: Tiếng chim mòng biển kêu là âm thanh của quê nhà.

sentences.en: Nowhere else would I feel comfortable enough to put my feet up under me and gaze into the log fire dreaming of the future.
sentences.vi: Không nơi nào khác tôi có thể cảm thấy đủ thoải mái để gác chân lên ghế và ngồi nhìn vào ngọn lửa, mơ về tương lai.

paragraphs.text: I was 15 when I first went away from home on a school trip to Germany. My friends were going too, but we would all stay with different families. I was nervous about this. I knew the home I was going to would not be as comfortable as mine, the family would not be as kind, and who knew what the German food would be like? I knew I would spend three weeks, homesick and sad, missing my family back home.

sentences.en: I was 15 when I first went away from home on a school trip to Germany.
sentences.vi: Tôi 15 tuổi khi lần đầu tiên xa nhà trong một chuyến đi của trường tới Đức.

sentences.en: My friends were going too, but we would all stay with different families.
sentences.vi: Bạn bè tôi cũng đi, nhưng tất cả chúng tôi sẽ ở với những gia đình khác nhau.

sentences.en: I was nervous about this.
sentences.vi: Tôi rất lo lắng về điều này.

sentences.en: I knew the home I was going to would not be as comfortable as mine, the family would not be as kind, and who knew what the German food would be like?
sentences.vi: Tôi biết ngôi nhà mà mình sắp ở sẽ không thoải mái như nhà mình, gia đình đó sẽ không tử tế bằng gia đình tôi, và ai mà biết được đồ ăn Đức sẽ như thế nào?

sentences.en: I knew I would spend three weeks, homesick and sad, missing my family back home.
sentences.vi: Tôi biết mình sẽ phải trải qua ba tuần, nhớ gia đình ở quê nhà.

paragraphs.text: We arrived in Germany late at night after a long journey by coach and boat. I was tired and hungry. We went into the school hall, where the host families were waiting to meet us. I wondered which one would be mine. Would they give me dinner at this time and would I be able to eat the unfamiliar food? Suddenly I heard my name called and the name of my exchange partner, Brigitte Schmitt. A pretty, blonde girl stepped forward, smiling widely. Behind her stood her parents, a pleasant-looking couple who were also smiling. They held out their hands and said, 'Wilkommen in Deutschland. Welcome to Germany.'

sentences.en: We arrived in Germany late at night after a long journey by coach and boat. I was tired and hungry.
sentences.vi: Chúng tôi đến Đức vào đêm muộn sau một hành trình dài bằng xe khách và tàu thủy. Tôi mệt và đói.

sentences.en: We went into the school hall, where the host families were waiting to meet us.
sentences.vi: Chúng tôi bước vào hội trường của trường, nơi những gia đình chủ nhà đang chờ để gặp chúng tôi.

sentences.en: I wondered which one would be mine.
sentences.vi: Tôi tự hỏi gia đình nào sẽ là gia đình của mình.

sentences.en: Suddenly I heard my name called and the name of my exchange partner, Brigitte Schmitt.
sentences.vi: Đột nhiên, tôi nghe thấy tên mình được gọi cùng với tên của bạn học cùng chương trình trao đổi, Brigitte Schmitt.

sentences.en: Behind her stood her parents, a pleasant-looking couple who were also smiling.
sentences.vi: Đứng phía sau cô ấy là bố mẹ cô, một cặp vợ chồng trông dễ mến và cũng đang mỉm cười.

sentences.en: They held out their hands and said, 'Wilkommen in Deutschland. Welcome to Germany.'
sentences.vi: Họ chìa tay ra và nói: 'Willkommen in Deutschland. Chào mừng đến với nước Đức.'

paragraphs.text: I spent three happy weeks with the Schmitt family. Brigitte had an elder brother, Hendrik, and a younger sister, Lisa. They had two cats, Ping and Pong, who sat on my lap as I looked into the fire in the evenings. The whole family were kind and welcoming. My room was cosy and warm and we looked out onto a forest. The fresh clean smell of the trees and of apples baking in the oven became familiar and comforting, like the smells of home. I learnt in those three weeks that you can feel at home anywhere that people are kind to you.

sentences.en: I spent three happy weeks with the Schmitt family.
sentences.vi: Tôi đã trải qua ba tuần vui vẻ cùng gia đình Schmitt.

sentences.en: They had two cats, Ping and Pong, who sat on my lap as I looked into the fire in the evenings.
sentences.vi: Họ có hai chú mèo, Ping và Pong, chúng thường ngồi trong lòng tôi khi tôi nhìn vào ngọn lửa vào buổi tối.

sentences.en: My room was cosy and warm and we looked out onto a forest.
sentences.vi: Căn phòng của tôi ấm áp, dễ chịu và nhìn ra một khu rừng.

sentences.en: I learnt in those three weeks that you can feel at home anywhere that people are kind to you.
sentences.vi: Trong ba tuần đó, tôi đã học được rằng bạn có thể cảm thấy như đang ở nhà ở bất cứ nơi nào mà mọi người đối xử tốt với bạn.

paragraphs.text: Later that year, Brigitte came to stay with me in the UK. I gave her my room and moved in with my brother. I cleared space for her clothes and put fresh flowers in a vase by the bed. I asked my mum to make her famous roast chicken and an apple pie to make our guest feel at home. We made a welcome banner and put it up on the front door. I did everything I could to help Brigitte feel at home with us. I now understood the importance of a warm welcome.

sentences.en: Later that year, Brigitte came to stay with me in the UK.
sentences.vi: Cuối năm đó, Brigitte đến ở cùng tôi tại Vương quốc Anh.

sentences.en: I asked my mum to make her famous roast chicken and an apple pie to make our guest feel at home.
sentences.vi: Tôi nhờ mẹ làm món gà quay nổi tiếng của bà và một chiếc bánh táo để vị khách của chúng tôi cảm thấy như đang ở nhà.

sentences.en: I did everything I could to help Brigitte feel at home with us.
sentences.vi: Tôi đã làm tất cả những gì có thể để giúp Brigitte cảm thấy thoải mái như ở nhà khi ở cùng chúng tôi.

sentences.en: I now understood the importance of a warm welcome.
sentences.vi: Giờ đây, tôi đã hiểu được tầm quan trọng của một lời chào đón nồng nhiệt.

questions.text: The writer's mother often cooks _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1: 'my mum's roast chicken in the oven'

questions.text: She thought the visit to Germany would make her feel _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: 'spend three weeks, homesick and sad'

questions.text: Brigitte came to pick up the girl with _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: 'Behind her stood her parents'

questions.text: The Schmitt family's pets' names are _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 4: 'They had two cats, Ping and Pong'

questions.text: From her bedroom the girl could see _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 4: 'we looked out onto a forest'

questions.text: The girl and her family tried hard to make Brigitte _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 5: 'to help Brigitte feel at home with us'

activities.title: FOOD CULTURE SHOCK
activities.questionsInstruction: Complete these sentences using a word from the text.

paragraphs.text: CHARLES: You would think that eating with your fingers would be easy. In the US, there are only certain things you can eat with your fingers, like burgers, for example, and that is easy enough. When I went to South India, though, I realised that it is a whole new skill to learn to eat rice and curry with your fingers. You have to mix the curries together and with the rice and form a ball. Daal is particularly helpful as a kind of glue. You use your fingertips, never the palm of your hand, and use your thumb to pop it into your mouth. I thought I knew where my mouth was, but my first few attempts were a disaster. There was food everywhere!

sentences.en: When I went to South India, though, I realised that it is a whole new skill to learn to eat rice and curry with your fingers.
sentences.vi: Tuy nhiên, khi đến miền Nam Ấn Độ, tôi nhận ra rằng ăn cơm và cà ri bằng tay là cả một kỹ năng hoàn toàn mới cần phải học.

sentences.en: You use your fingertips, never the palm of your hand, and use your thumb to pop it into your mouth.
sentences.vi: Bạn dùng các đầu ngón tay, tuyệt đối không dùng lòng bàn tay, và dùng ngón cái để đẩy thức ăn vào miệng.

paragraphs.text: ALFREDO: For me, when I travel, the 'fast food' culture always shocks me. I can't believe there are people in the world who live on 'junk food' like burgers and just grab a sandwich for lunch. Back home, food is very important to us. Food is part of your identity, so what are you saying about yourself when you eat some rubbish which contains chemicals and goodness knows what else?

sentences.en: Back home, food is very important to us.
sentences.vi: Ở quê tôi, đồ ăn rất quan trọng đối với chúng tôi.

sentences.en: Food is part of your identity, so what are you saying about yourself when you eat some rubbish which contains chemicals?
sentences.vi: Thức ăn là một phần bản sắc của bạn, vậy bạn đang nói gì về chính mình khi ăn những thứ đồ ăn tạp nham chứa hóa chất?

paragraphs.text: QIANG SHI: I enjoy trying food from different countries, but what interests me more is the culture and habits surrounding food and eating. In China, when we go to a restaurant with colleagues, when we are offered something, we say 'No thanks', even though we want it, because the person will definitely repeat the offer. In other countries, though, 'no' means 'no', so if you are trying to be polite and don't take it the first time, you will end up with nothing!

sentences.en: In China, when we go to a restaurant with colleagues, when we are offered something, we say 'No thanks', even though we want it, because the person will definitely repeat the offer.
sentences.vi: Ở Trung Quốc, khi chúng tôi đi ăn nhà hàng cùng đồng nghiệp, khi được mời một món gì đó, chúng tôi sẽ nói 'Không, cảm ơn', mặc dù chúng tôi muốn món đó, bởi vì người mời chắc chắn sẽ tiếp tục mời.

paragraphs.text: PAULINE: Being a vegetarian is so easy here in the UK that we forget that not everyone in the world understands vegetarianism. In many parts of the world, meat equates to prosperity, so the idea of going out for a meal and not having meat is alien to them.

sentences.en: In many parts of the world, meat equates to prosperity, so the idea of going out for a meal and not having meat is alien to them.
sentences.vi: Ở nhiều nơi trên thế giới, thịt đồng nghĩa với sự sung túc, vì vậy ý tưởng ra ngoài ăn một bữa mà không có thịt là điều xa lạ đối với họ.

paragraphs.text: AILEEN: I think breakfast is the meal where food culture really hits you. But when I travelled in Asia, I realised that in many places, there is no difference between breakfast and dinner: rice, curry, noodles, soup, steamed vegetables and fish all appeared at breakfast.

activities.title: OUR FRIENDS AND PROTECTORS
activities.questionsInstruction: Complete the notes below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO/THREE WORDS from the passage.

paragraphs.text: When asked their favourite animals, many people answer 'dolphins'. They are known as friendly, intelligent creatures that have a special relationship with humans. For example, dolphins can tell when a woman is pregnant. They can also tell when someone is in trouble.

sentences.en: When asked their favourite animals, many people answer 'dolphins'.
sentences.vi: Khi được hỏi về loài động vật yêu thích, nhiều người trả lời là 'cá heo'.

paragraphs.text: There are many stories about dolphins protecting humans from sharks. Wildlife filmmaker Hardy Jones was filming a group of dolphins, when a large shark swam towards him ready to attack. Four dolphins came to his rescue and drove the shark away. Perhaps they could tell he was a person who cared very much about dolphins. In fact, Jones was a well-known campaigner against the killing of dolphins.

sentences.en: Wildlife filmmaker Hardy Jones was filming a group of dolphins, when a large shark swam towards him ready to attack.
sentences.vi: Nhà làm phim về động vật hoang dã Hardy Jones đang quay phim một đàn cá heo thì một con cá mập lớn bơi về phía ông, sẵn sàng tấn công.

sentences.en: In fact, Jones was a well-known campaigner against the killing of dolphins.
sentences.vi: Thực tế, Jones là một nhà vận động nổi tiếng chống lại việc giết hại cá heo.

paragraphs.text: Whales have also been known to protect both humans and other mammals. In California, in 2012, a BBC Planet Earth film crew filmed a group of humpback whales who were protecting migrating grey whales from attacks by orcas (killer whales) over a period of at least seven hours. In China, Yang Yun applied for a job training whales at Polar Land in the city of Harbin. When she was about five metres down, Yang Yun found she couldn't move her legs due to the freezing temperatures. Two beluga whales, Mila and Nicola, sensed that she was in trouble. Mila gripped Yang Yun's leg in her mouth and pushed Yun to the surface, saving her life.

sentences.en: In California, in 2012, a BBC Planet Earth film crew filmed a group of humpback whales who were protecting migrating grey whales from attacks by orcas over a period of at least seven hours.
sentences.vi: Tại California vào năm 2012, đoàn làm phim Planet Earth đã quay cảnh cá voi lưng gù bảo vệ cá voi xám di cư khỏi cá voi sát thủ trong ít nhất 7 giờ.

sentences.en: Yang Yun found she couldn't move her legs due to the freezing temperatures.
sentences.vi: Yang Yun phát hiện mình không thể cử động chân do nhiệt độ quá lạnh.

sentences.en: Mila gripped Yang Yun's leg in her mouth and pushed Yun to the surface, saving her life.
sentences.vi: Mila ngoạm chân Yang Yun trong miệng rồi đẩy Yun lên mặt nước, cứu sống cô.

questions.explanation: Đoạn B: Wildlife filmmaker Hardy Jones was filming a group of dolphins...

questions.explanation: Đoạn B: 'In fact, Jones was a well-known campaigner...'

questions.explanation: Đoạn E: 'protecting migrating grey whales from attacks by orcas'

questions.explanation: Đoạn E: 'over a period of at least seven hours'

questions.explanation: Đoạn E: 'couldn't move her legs due to the freezing temperatures'

questions.explanation: Đoạn E: 'Mila gripped Yang Yun's leg in her mouth'

activities.title: THE MODERN ZOO
activities.questionsInstruction: Complete the notes below. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage for each answer.

paragraphs.text: The first zoo is believed to have been in Egypt in around 3500 BC. Early collections of animals on display often belonged to royalty. Until the late twentieth century, the main purpose of zoos was for entertainment. In 1959, famous wildlife expert Gerald Durrell opened the first zoo which put conservation of animals first.

sentences.en: Until the late twentieth century, the main purpose of zoos was for entertainment.
sentences.vi: Cho đến cuối thế kỷ 20, mục đích chính của các vườn thú vẫn là phục vụ nhu cầu giải trí.

sentences.en: In 1959, famous wildlife expert Gerald Durrell opened the first zoo which put conservation of animals first.
sentences.vi: Năm 1959, chuyên gia Gerald Durrell đã mở vườn thú đầu tiên đặt việc bảo tồn lên hàng đầu.

paragraphs.text: From the 1990s, zoos began to see their main role as saving the most threatened species. Often the aim is to reintroduce endangered species into their natural habitats. In Indonesia, Borneo Orangutan Rescue teaches orangutans how to live in the wild.

sentences.en: Often the aim is to reintroduce endangered species into their natural habitats.
sentences.vi: Mục tiêu thường là đưa các loài có nguy cơ tuyệt chủng trở lại môi trường sống tự nhiên của chúng.

sentences.en: In Indonesia, Borneo Orangutan Rescue teaches orangutans how to live in the wild.
sentences.vi: Tại Indonesia, Trung tâm Cứu hộ Đười ươi Borneo dạy những con đười ươi cách sống trong tự nhiên.

paragraphs.text: Zoos try to provide 'enrichment' for the animals to improve their wellbeing. This includes climbing frames, feeding puzzles, unusual objects and different types of food.

sentences.en: Zoos try to provide 'enrichment' for the animals to improve their wellbeing.
sentences.vi: Các vườn thú cố gắng cung cấp những hình thức 'làm phong phú môi trường sống' nhằm cải thiện chất lượng sống.

paragraphs.text: Likewise, technology has been used to engage the public more with the animals. In many zoos there are webcams in some enclosures so visitors can keep up with their favourite animals between visits to the zoo.

sentences.en: In many zoos there are webcams in some enclosures so visitors can keep up with their favourite animals between visits to the zoo.
sentences.vi: Ở nhiều vườn thú có lắp webcam để du khách theo dõi từ xa.

questions.explanation: Đoạn A: 'the main purpose of zoos was for entertainment'

questions.explanation: Đoạn A: 'In 1959, famous wildlife expert Gerald Durrell opened...'

questions.explanation: Đoạn B: 'reintroduce endangered species into their natural habitats'

questions.explanation: Đoạn C: 'Zoos try to provide enrichment for the animals'

questions.explanation: Đoạn D: 'webcams in some enclosures so visitors can keep up...'
